verdict.rationale: Restate's first-party docs describe an official CLI for managing services, deployments and invocations, and for inspecting invocation and application state. A probe confirms the CLI is documented on the installation page. missing for 10: detailed command reference or agent-oriented CLI features in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can use the CLI to interact with Restate, and manage your services, deployments and invocations.
Restate exposes information on invocations and application state via its CLI and Introspection SQL API.
